words.enDefinition: the university office that provides counseling and support

examples.en: I stopped at the campus counseling center after my afternoon seminar finished early.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课提前结束后，我去了趟「校内心理咨询中心」。

examples.en: The campus counseling center sent me a map showing its entrance from the courtyard.
examples.zh: 「校内心理咨询中心」发给我一张图，标出了从庭院进去的入口。

words.enDefinition: a university service supporting students with mental health concerns

examples.en: The student mental health service had a separate page for students studying abroad.
examples.zh: 「学生心理健康服务」网站给在海外学习的学生单独设了一个页面。

examples.en: I called the student mental health service to ask what support was available.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「学生心理健康服务」部门，询问有哪些支持。

collocations: contact the student mental health service
information from the student mental health service
use a student mental health service

words.enDefinition: a first conversation to understand concerns and arrange suitable counseling

examples.en: The counseling intake took place in a small room near the reception desk.
examples.zh: 「心理咨询初评」在前台附近的一间小房间里进行。

examples.en: I asked whether the counseling intake would be by phone or in person.
examples.zh: 我问了「心理咨询初评」是打电话做，还是要本人到场。

words.enDefinition: the first meeting a client has with a counselor

examples.en: I asked what to expect from an initial counseling session at the university.
examples.zh: 我问了在学校做「首次心理咨询」一般会聊些什么。

examples.en: My initial counseling session was on the same day as my last lecture.
examples.zh: 我的「首次心理咨询」和我最后一节课安排在同一天。

words.enDefinition: a later meeting with a counselor to continue the conversation

examples.en: My follow-up counseling session was online because I was already home for the break.
examples.zh: 我已经回家过假期了，所以「后续心理咨询」在线上进行。

examples.en: I made a note of the date for my follow-up counseling session before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，我把「后续心理咨询」的日期记了下来。

words.enDefinition: counseling available during designated hours without a prior booking

examples.en: The sign said drop-in counseling was available on Thursday afternoons at the student centre.
examples.zh: 标牌上写着，学生中心周四下午有「无需预约的心理咨询」。

examples.en: I asked where to wait for drop-in counseling after arriving at the new building.
examples.zh: 到新楼后，我问了「无需预约的心理咨询」在哪里等候。

words.enDefinition: counseling with appointments available on the day of contact

examples.en: The website showed where to check for same-day counseling during the exam period.
examples.zh: 网站上写了考试期间在哪里查「当天可约的心理咨询」。

examples.en: I called about same-day counseling before my afternoon shift at the university library.
examples.zh: 去大学图书馆上下午班前，我打电话问了「当天可约的心理咨询」。

words.enDefinition: counseling offered over a limited number of meetings

examples.en: The adviser explained how brief counseling was organised for students during the term.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了学期内学校怎样为学生安排「短程心理咨询」。

examples.en: I asked whether brief counseling referred to the number or length of the sessions.
examples.zh: 我问「短程心理咨询」指次数少，还是每次时间短。

words.enDefinition: private sessions between a client and a counselor

examples.en: I read about individual counseling on the same page that listed the support groups.
examples.zh: 我在列出互助小组的同一页看到了「一对一心理咨询」的介绍。

examples.en: The service offered individual counseling, and my first session was in the main building.
examples.zh: 学校提供「一对一心理咨询」，我第一次去的是主楼。

words.enDefinition: a group where people with shared experiences support each other

examples.en: My adviser introduced me to a peer support group for first-year international students.
examples.zh: 顾问给我介绍了一个面向大一国际学生的「同伴互助小组」。

examples.en: The peer support group meets in the student centre on alternate Mondays during term.
examples.zh: 学期里，「同伴互助小组」每隔一个周一在学生中心见面。

words.enDefinition: a mutual support group guided by a designated person

examples.en: The brochure described a facilitated support group run by two staff members on campus.
examples.zh: 宣传册介绍了一个由校内两位工作人员组织的「有带领者的互助小组」。

examples.en: I asked whether the facilitated support group would stay with the same members all term.
examples.zh: 我问「有带领者的互助小组」一整个学期是不是都由同一批人参加。

words.enDefinition: a list of people waiting for counseling appointments

examples.en: The adviser added me to the counseling waitlist and confirmed my contact details.
examples.zh: 顾问把我加到「心理咨询候补名单」上，并确认了我的联系方式。

examples.en: I checked whether I was still on the counseling waitlist after the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假过后，我查了自己是否还在「心理咨询候补名单」上。

collocations: contact people on a counseling waitlist

words.enDefinition: a recommendation directing someone to a counseling service

examples.en: The nurse sent a counseling referral after I asked which services the university offered.
examples.zh: 我问了学校有哪些服务后，护士发出了一份「心理咨询转介」。

examples.en: I asked where the counseling referral would go after the initial meeting with my adviser.
examples.zh: 我问第一次跟顾问见面后，「心理咨询转介」会发给哪个部门。

collocations: follow up on a counseling referral

words.enDefinition: counseling conducted through an internet platform rather than face to face

examples.en: I arranged online counseling while I was spending the semester at another university.
examples.zh: 在另一所学校交换的那个学期，我约了「网络心理咨询」。

examples.en: The email explained how to join online counseling from a private space on campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说了从校内比较私密的地方怎么加入「网络心理咨询」。

words.enDefinition: counseling delivered through a telephone call

examples.en: The centre offered telephone counseling when I could not join the video call.
examples.zh: 我没法参加视频通话时，中心提供了「电话心理咨询」。

examples.en: I checked which number would call me for telephone counseling on Monday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我查了周一下午安排的「电话心理咨询」会从哪个号码打来。

words.enDefinition: counseling where information is protected under rules and agreed limits

examples.en: The website describes confidential counseling and links to the service's privacy information.
examples.zh: 网站介绍了「保密心理咨询」，并链接到服务的隐私说明。

examples.en: Before sharing anything, I asked how confidential counseling worked at this university.
examples.zh: 讲自己的事之前，我先问了本校的「保密心理咨询」是怎么做的。

words.enDefinition: information kept by a service about counseling appointments and care

examples.en: The counselor explained where counseling records were stored and who could access them at our centre.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了本中心的「心理咨询记录」存在哪里、谁能查阅。

examples.en: I asked whether my counseling records could go to the new provider with my consent.
examples.zh: 我问了经我同意，能否把我的「心理咨询记录」转给新的服务机构。

words.enDefinition: the rules for protecting and sharing personal information

examples.en: I read the confidentiality policy before filling out the counseling intake paperwork online.
examples.zh: 在网上填心理咨询初评材料之前，我先读了「保密政策」。

examples.en: The counselor pointed out a section of the confidentiality policy that I had missed.
examples.zh: 咨询师给我指出了「保密政策」中我漏看的一节。

words.enDefinition: circumstances in which information may be shared under applicable rules

examples.en: The counselor explained the limits of confidentiality before our first conversation on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五第一次谈话前，咨询师解释了哪些情况属于「保密范围的例外」。

examples.en: I asked about the limits of confidentiality while reading the consent form at home.
examples.zh: 我在家读同意书时，对「保密范围的例外」提出了疑问。

words.enDefinition: a client's agreement to receive counseling after learning about it

examples.en: The form asks for consent to counseling and explains how the centre handles records.
examples.zh: 表格询问是否「同意接受心理咨询」，还说明了中心如何处理记录。

examples.en: I asked the counselor about the wording of consent to counseling before signing.
examples.zh: 签字前，我向咨询师问了「同意接受心理咨询」那一栏的措辞。

words.enDefinition: a trained professional who helps people discuss personal or emotional concerns

examples.en: My counselor asked what I wanted to get out of our first meeting.
examples.zh: 我的「心理咨询师」问我，希望第一次见面能谈出些什么。

examples.en: I asked the counselor which room we would use for the next session.
examples.zh: 我问「心理咨询师」，下次咨询会用哪个房间。

words.enDefinition: a counselor authorised to practise under a local licensing system

examples.en: The website identifies each licensed counselor by name and lists their training and qualifications.
examples.zh: 网站列出了每位「持证心理咨询师」的姓名、受训经历和资质。

examples.en: I asked whether the referral list included a licensed counselor who spoke Mandarin.
examples.zh: 我问转介名单里有没有说普通话的「持证心理咨询师」。

words.enDefinition: a psychology professional trained in assessing and treating mental health concerns

examples.en: The university website says a clinical psychologist helps oversee its student assessment service.
examples.zh: 学校网站说，一位「临床心理学家」参与监督学生评估服务。

examples.en: I looked up the clinical psychologist named in the email from student health.
examples.zh: 我查了学生健康服务发来的邮件中提到的那位「临床心理学家」。

words.enDefinition: a professional who practises psychological therapy through structured sessions

examples.en: I asked whether the psychotherapist saw students in person during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我问「心理治疗师」在暑假是否还会和学生面谈。

examples.en: The psychotherapist explained how our sessions would be arranged around my class schedule.
examples.zh: 「心理治疗师」解释了会如何参照我的课表安排咨询时间。

words.enDefinition: a medical doctor specialising in mental health conditions

examples.en: The student health service sent me contact details for a psychiatrist near campus.
examples.zh: 学生健康服务发给我一位学校附近「精神科医生」的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked whether the psychiatrist would need the notes from my previous appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「精神科医生」需不需要上次看诊的记录。

words.enDefinition: a staff member helping students find wellbeing support

examples.en: I met the student wellbeing adviser after my tutor mentioned the service.
examples.zh: 导师提到了这项服务之后，我见了「学生身心健康顾问」。

examples.en: The student wellbeing adviser emailed me an overview of the support available on campus.
examples.zh: 「学生身心健康顾问」发邮件给我，概述了校内可提供的支持。

words.enDefinition: a social worker supporting people with mental health needs

examples.en: The mental health social worker explained how to contact the university's support office.
examples.zh: 「心理健康社工」解释了如何联系学校的支持办公室。

examples.en: I met a mental health social worker when I wanted help arranging services after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后想接着安排相关服务，我见了一位「心理健康社工」。

collocations: meet a mental health social worker
contact a mental health social worker
referral to a mental health social worker

words.enDefinition: a person who offers support to others with shared experience

examples.en: A peer supporter helped me find the room where the international student group meets.
examples.zh: 一位「同伴支持人员」帮我找到了国际学生小组聚会的房间。

examples.en: I spoke to a peer supporter at the orientation fair about available campus groups.
examples.zh: 在迎新活动上，我向「同伴支持人员」打听校内有哪些小组。

words.enDefinition: a form with questions to answer before a session

examples.en: I completed the pre-session questionnaire during a quiet moment before the counseling office opened.
examples.zh: 咨询办公室开门前，我趁空填了「咨询前问卷」。

examples.en: The counselor asked if anything had changed since I submitted the pre-session questionnaire.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，我提交「咨询前问卷」后情况有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: changes or outcomes a client wants to work towards in counseling

examples.en: We talked about my counseling goals after I described what had brought me there.
examples.zh: 我说完为什么来做咨询后，我们谈了我的「心理咨询目标」。

examples.en: I wrote down two counseling goals to discuss at the start of my next visit.
examples.zh: 我记下了两个「心理咨询目标」，准备下次会面一开始就讨论。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting with a therapist for psychological care

examples.en: My therapy session ended just before the last bus back to my student housing.
examples.zh: 我的「心理治疗会谈」在回学生宿舍的末班车之前刚好结束。

examples.en: I asked whether we could hold the next therapy session online during the holiday.
examples.zh: 我问能否把下次「心理治疗会谈」安排在假期线上进行。

words.enDefinition: a therapy meeting where a professional works with several clients together

examples.en: The group therapy session began once everyone had found a seat in the circle.
examples.zh: 大家围成一圈坐好后，「团体心理治疗会谈」开始了。

examples.en: I checked how many people would attend the group therapy session before signing up.
examples.zh: 报名之前，我问了会有多少人参加「团体心理治疗会谈」。

words.enDefinition: psychological treatment involving discussion with a trained practitioner

examples.en: I wanted to understand what talking therapy meant before contacting the service.
examples.zh: 联系这项服务前，我想先弄清「谈话心理治疗」是什么意思。

examples.en: The leaflet listed several kinds of talking therapy offered by the community clinic.
examples.zh: 宣传页列举了社区诊所提供的几种「谈话心理治疗」。

words.enDefinition: a therapy addressing links between thoughts, feelings and behaviour

examples.en: The clinician explained the name cognitive behavioral therapy after I saw it in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我在小册子里看到「认知行为疗法」这个词后，治疗师给我作了解释。

examples.en: The university invited someone to speak about cognitive behavioral therapy at the wellbeing fair.
examples.zh: 学校邀请了一位讲者在身心健康活动上介绍「认知行为疗法」。

words.enDefinition: a therapy focusing on relationships and important life changes

examples.en: The counselor briefly explained interpersonal therapy when we discussed the service's leaflet together.
examples.zh: 我们一起看宣传页时，咨询师简要介绍了「人际心理治疗」。

examples.en: I first heard the term interpersonal therapy during a seminar about campus wellbeing.
examples.zh: 我第一次听到「人际心理治疗」，是在一场校园身心健康研讨会上。

words.enDefinition: a therapy centred on the person's own experiences and choices

examples.en: The brochure mentioned person-centered therapy and explained what sessions could look like at the clinic.
examples.zh: 宣传册提到了「以人为中心疗法」，还介绍了在诊所会怎么进行。

examples.en: I asked my counselor what person-centered therapy meant in the description of her work.
examples.zh: 我问咨询师，她介绍的工作中「以人为中心疗法」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a group focused on learning and practising a defined set of skills

examples.en: The counseling centre runs a skills group that meets once a week during term.
examples.zh: 咨询中心有个「技能练习小组」，学期里每周见一次。

examples.en: I asked whether the skills group was open to students from other departments.
examples.zh: 我问其他院系的学生能不能参加这个「技能练习小组」。

words.enDefinition: the person who guides discussion and participation in a group

examples.en: The group facilitator explained how we would take turns speaking during the meeting.
examples.zh: 「小组带领者」说明了开会时大家怎么轮流发言。

examples.en: I asked the group facilitator when the next wellbeing workshop would take place.
examples.zh: 我向「小组带领者」打听下一场身心健康工作坊什么时候开。

words.enDefinition: shared rules for the way members take part in a group

examples.en: We read the group agreement before the first meeting of the peer support group.
examples.zh: 同伴互助小组第一次见面前，我们读了「小组共同约定」。

examples.en: The facilitator checked whether anyone had questions about the group agreement we had just read.
examples.zh: 带领者问大家，对刚读过的「小组共同约定」有没有疑问。

words.enDefinition: written notes about what happened at a counseling or therapy meeting

examples.en: I asked whether I could see my session notes after meeting the counselor.
examples.zh: 和咨询师见面后，我问能不能看自己的「会谈记录」。

examples.en: The therapist explained how she keeps session notes at the student health service.
examples.zh: 治疗师说明了她在学生健康服务部门怎么保存「会谈记录」。

words.enDefinition: a professional discussion about how to support a particular client

examples.en: The counselor explained what a case consultation meant in the centre's privacy information.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了中心隐私说明里的「个案讨论」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which staff members attended a case consultation at the counselling service.
examples.zh: 我问咨询机构哪些工作人员会参加「个案讨论」。

words.enDefinition: the move from one healthcare setting or provider to another

examples.en: My counselor helped arrange a transition of care before I left the university.
examples.zh: 我离开学校之前，咨询师帮我安排了「照护交接」。

examples.en: The clinic asked for consent to share records during the transition of care.
examples.zh: 诊所征求我的同意，想在「照护交接」期间共享记录。

words.enDefinition: the ability to choose which therapist to see

examples.en: I asked whether the service offered a choice of therapist for online sessions.
examples.zh: 我问在线上接受咨询时，有没有「选择治疗师的余地」。

examples.en: The intake adviser explained how much choice of therapist students had at the centre.
examples.zh: 初评顾问介绍了在中心接受咨询的学生有多少「选择治疗师的余地」。

collocations: ask about the choice of therapist

words.enDefinition: the professional working relationship between a client and therapist

examples.en: We read about the therapeutic relationship during a workshop at the counseling centre.
examples.zh: 我们在咨询中心的工作坊里读到了「治疗关系」的相关介绍。

examples.en: The counselor said we could discuss the therapeutic relationship if any concerns came up.
examples.zh: 咨询师说，有任何顾虑都可以谈谈「治疗关系」。

words.enDefinition: to request a change to another counselor

examples.en: I asked the receptionist how to ask for a different counselor if needed.
examples.zh: 我问前台，必要时该怎么「请求更换咨询师」。

examples.en: The leaflet says where to ask for a different counselor at the campus centre.
examples.zh: 宣传页上写了可以在校内中心什么地方「请求更换咨询师」。

collocations: can I ask for a different counselor
want to ask for a different counselor
how to ask for a different counselor

words.enDefinition: to arrange a time to meet with a counselor

examples.en: I used the student portal to book a counseling session after my exam.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，我用学生门户「预约了一次心理咨询」。

examples.en: The reception desk explained who could book a counseling session at the university.
examples.zh: 前台说明了哪些人可以在学校「预约一次心理咨询」。

collocations: book a counseling session by phone
book a counseling session in advance

words.enDefinition: to arrange a new time for an existing counseling appointment

examples.en: I had to reschedule a counseling session because the department moved my lab.
examples.zh: 院里调整了我的实验课时间，我只好「改约心理咨询」。

examples.en: The website says to call reception if you want to reschedule a counseling session.
examples.zh: 网站写着，想「改约心理咨询」的话可以打给前台。

collocations: call to reschedule a counseling session
ask to reschedule a counseling session
need to reschedule a counseling session

words.enDefinition: a counseling appointment the person did not attend

examples.en: I emailed reception about a missed counseling appointment from earlier in the week.
examples.zh: 这周早些时候有次「未到场的咨询预约」，我为此给前台发了邮件。

examples.en: The centre said I could contact the desk about my missed counseling appointment.
examples.zh: 中心说我可以联系前台，了解那次「未到场的咨询预约」怎么处理。

collocations: follow up on a missed counseling appointment
email about a missed counseling appointment

words.enDefinition: the times when a counselor has space to meet someone

examples.en: The student portal shows counselor availability for the next two weeks at our university.
examples.zh: 学生门户列出了本校未来两周「咨询师的可约时间」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist about counselor availability during the winter break and exam week.
examples.zh: 我问前台寒假和考试周「咨询师的可约时间」。

words.enDefinition: assistance available outside a service's ordinary opening hours

examples.en: The website explains where students can find out-of-hours support during the winter break.
examples.zh: 网站说明了学生寒假期间在哪里能找到「非工作时间支持」。

examples.en: I wrote down the details for out-of-hours support listed in the student handbook.
examples.zh: 我记下了学生手册里列的「非工作时间支持」信息。

words.enDefinition: a central campus location for finding wellbeing services

examples.en: The campus wellbeing hub was open when I passed the main library at lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭时路过主图书馆，「校园身心健康服务站」开着。

examples.en: My tutor sent me a link to the campus wellbeing hub before the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假前，导师给我发了「校园身心健康服务站」的链接。

words.enDefinition: the people or organisations someone can turn to for help

examples.en: My support network now includes friends from the course and people at home.
examples.zh: 我的「支持网络」现在包括课程里的朋友和家乡的人。

examples.en: We talked about who was in my support network when I moved abroad.
examples.zh: 我搬到国外后，我们聊了聊哪些人属于我的「支持网络」。

words.enDefinition: to contact someone to ask for help or understanding

examples.en: It took me a while to reach out for support after moving overseas.
examples.zh: 搬到国外一段时间后，我才「主动寻求支持」。

examples.en: We talked about how to reach out for support during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 迎新会上，我们讨论了怎么「主动寻求支持」。

collocations: decide to reach out for support
encourage someone to reach out for support
feel able to reach out for support

words.enDefinition: care and understanding offered when someone is upset or struggling

examples.en: I found emotional support in a group that meets after the evening lecture.
examples.zh: 下午晚些时候下课后有个聚会小组，我在那里得到了「情绪支持」。

examples.en: We talked about the difference between emotional support and help with practical tasks.
examples.zh: 我们聊了聊「情绪支持」和帮忙做实际事务有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: how well someone is able to experience and handle emotions

examples.en: Our seminar discussed how moving away from home can affect emotional wellbeing over time.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论了离家生活如何逐渐影响「情绪健康」。

examples.en: The student survey asked about emotional wellbeing during the first month on campus.
examples.zh: 学生调查问到了到校第一个月的「情绪健康」。

words.enDefinition: a lack of regular social contact or connection with other people

examples.en: The workshop discussed social isolation among students who live far from the main campus.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了住得离主校区较远的学生面临的「社交孤立」。

examples.en: I wanted to know how the student association addressed social isolation during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我想了解学生会在假期怎么回应「社交孤立」的问题。

words.enDefinition: problems getting used to a new situation or change

examples.en: I mentioned adjustment difficulties at my first meeting with the student wellbeing adviser.
examples.zh: 第一次见学生身心健康顾问时，我提到了自己的「适应困难」。

examples.en: The guide talks about adjustment difficulties during the first term of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 指南谈到了留学第一个学期的「适应困难」。

words.enDefinition: stress related to courses, grades or academic demands

examples.en: I told my adviser how academic pressure had changed since the start of term.
examples.zh: 我告诉顾问，开学以来我的「学业压力」是怎么变化的。

examples.en: The workshop focused on academic pressure around weeks when several assignments are due.
examples.zh: 工作坊关注多个作业同时截止那几周的「学业压力」。

words.enDefinition: anxiety about presenting information in front of an audience

examples.en: I noticed presentation anxiety when my tutor assigned me the opening slide for our project.
examples.zh: 导师把项目开场那张幻灯片交给我时，我感觉到了「汇报焦虑」。

examples.en: The student workshop mentioned presentation anxiety during its discussion of speaking in class.
examples.zh: 学生工作坊在谈课堂发言时提到了「汇报焦虑」。

words.enDefinition: fear or worry about social situations and others' judgments

examples.en: My counselor asked which campus activities brought up social anxiety for me.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，哪些校园活动会让我感到「社交焦虑」。

examples.en: I read about social anxiety after finding it hard to speak during group projects.
examples.zh: 小组项目中开口发言让我觉得困难，之后我读了关于「社交焦虑」的资料。

words.enDefinition: fear or worry about being judged during a performance

examples.en: My music tutor asked how performance anxiety affected me during practice and auditions.
examples.zh: 音乐导师问，「表现焦虑」在练习和试演时对我有什么影响。

examples.en: The skills workshop included a discussion of performance anxiety before graded recitals at college.
examples.zh: 技能工作坊讨论了学院评分演奏会之前的「表现焦虑」。

words.enDefinition: unwanted thoughts that enter the mind and may feel upsetting

examples.en: I described the intrusive thoughts I had noticed while trying to concentrate in class.
examples.zh: 我描述了自己努力听课时留意到的「闯入性想法」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what the phrase intrusive thoughts meant to me personally.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，「闯入性想法」这个说法对我个人来说意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: thoughts that arrive quickly and are difficult to slow down

examples.en: I noticed racing thoughts in the evening even after all my coursework was finished.
examples.zh: 即使作业都做完了，晚上我还是发现自己「思绪飞转」。

examples.en: The counselor asked when the racing thoughts usually started and how long they lasted.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我通常从什么时候开始「思绪飞转」，会持续多久。

words.enDefinition: worry that continues for a long time or often returns

examples.en: I brought up persistent worry during my appointment at the student health centre.
examples.zh: 我在学生健康中心看诊时提到了「持续担忧」。

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the persistent worry began before or after I moved.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，「持续担忧」是在搬家之前还是之后开始的。

words.enDefinition: a period of feeling sad, down or lacking energy

examples.en: I described my low mood to the campus counselor during our first conversation.
examples.zh: 第一次谈话时，我向校内咨询师描述了自己的「情绪低落」。

examples.en: The student guide mentions low mood as something people sometimes discuss with an adviser.
examples.zh: 学生指南说，「情绪低落」是大家有时会和顾问谈起的情况。

words.enDefinition: differences in how a person feels over time

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the mood changes followed any particular pattern during the week.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，一周里的「情绪变化」有没有什么特别的规律。

examples.en: I wrote down my mood changes so I could describe them clearly at the appointment.
examples.zh: 我记下了自己的「情绪变化」，方便看诊时说清楚。

words.enDefinition: to feel tense and unable to settle

examples.en: I often feel on edge before meeting a new group of classmates.
examples.zh: 见新的同学小组前，我经常「感到紧张不安」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what happens when I feel on edge after class.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，下课后「感到紧张不安」时会有什么反应。

words.enDefinition: to feel unable to deal with everything happening at once

examples.en: I sometimes feel overwhelmed when several project deadlines fall in the same week.
examples.zh: 几项项目截止日期赶到同一周时，我有时「觉得应付不过来」。

examples.en: We talked about times when I feel overwhelmed at the student support meeting.
examples.zh: 在学生支持会上，我们聊了聊我什么时候会「觉得应付不过来」。

words.enDefinition: feeling emotionally drained after prolonged demands or strain

examples.en: I used the phrase emotional exhaustion to describe how I felt after exams.
examples.zh: 考试过后，我用「情绪耗竭」来描述自己的感受。

examples.en: The counselor asked how emotional exhaustion was affecting my time outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 咨询师问「情绪耗竭」对我的课外生活有什么影响。

words.enDefinition: reduced interest in activities that previously mattered to someone

examples.en: I mentioned a loss of interest in the clubs I used to enjoy.
examples.zh: 我提到，自己对以前喜欢的社团活动「兴趣减退」。

examples.en: We talked about when the loss of interest in my usual hobbies had started.
examples.zh: 我们谈了谈我从什么时候开始对平时的爱好「兴趣减退」。

words.enDefinition: feeling less willing or able to begin and continue activities

examples.en: I noticed a loss of motivation when I sat down to start my coursework.
examples.zh: 坐下来准备写作业时，我感到自己的「动力减退」。

examples.en: The adviser asked about loss of motivation after I described a difficult week.
examples.zh: 我讲了上周有多难熬后，顾问问起了「动力减退」的情况。

words.enDefinition: trouble relaxing and setting worries or tasks aside

examples.en: I described difficulty switching off when I went back to my room at night.
examples.zh: 我描述了自己晚上回房后「难以停止思虑」的情况。

examples.en: The workshop discussion included difficulty switching off after working on several projects at once.
examples.zh: 工作坊谈到了同时做几个项目后「难以停止思虑」的情况。

words.enDefinition: to become awake after having fallen asleep at night

examples.en: I sometimes wake up during the night and remember what I was worrying about.
examples.zh: 我有时会「夜间醒来」，然后想起之前在担心什么。

examples.en: The questionnaire asked how often I wake up during the night these days.
examples.zh: 问卷问我最近「夜间醒来」的频率。

collocations: often wake up during the night
repeatedly wake up during the night
tend to wake up during the night

words.enDefinition: feeling unusually sleepy during hours normally spent awake

examples.en: I noticed daytime sleepiness while trying to take notes in my morning lectures.
examples.zh: 我上午上课想记笔记时，发现自己「白天犯困」。

examples.en: The counselor asked how long daytime sleepiness had been affecting my afternoon study time.
examples.zh: 咨询师问「白天犯困」影响我下午学习有多久了。

words.enDefinition: a disruption to normal sleep habits or quality

examples.en: The student questionnaire asked about sleep disturbance over the past two weeks.
examples.zh: 学生问卷询问了过去两周「睡眠受扰」的情况。

examples.en: I told my counselor that sleep disturbance was affecting my concentration during lectures.
examples.zh: 我告诉咨询师，「睡眠受扰」影响了我上课时的注意力。

words.enDefinition: a record of when someone sleeps and wakes

examples.en: I showed the clinician the sleep diary I had kept during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我把假期记的「睡眠日记」给医生看。

examples.en: My sleep diary recorded when I woke up as well as my bedtime.
examples.zh: 我的「睡眠日记」记了何时醒来，也记了几点睡觉。

words.enDefinition: a record of feelings and the situations in which they occur

examples.en: I brought my mood diary to the meeting and talked about a few entries.
examples.zh: 我把「情绪日记」带到会谈里，聊了几条记录。

examples.en: The entries in my mood diary were mostly about coursework and relationships with friends.
examples.zh: 我「情绪日记」里的记录大多关于课程作业和与朋友的关系。

words.enDefinition: how much stress a person is experiencing

examples.en: My adviser asked whether my stress level changed during weeks with fewer deadlines.
examples.zh: 顾问问，在截止日期比较少的几周，我的「压力程度」会不会变化。

examples.en: The survey asked me to rate my stress level at the end of term.
examples.zh: 调查请我给学期末的「压力程度」打个分。

words.enDefinition: a situation or demand that causes stress for someone

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the move had been the biggest stressor that month.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，那个月搬家对我来说是不是最大的「压力源」。

examples.en: I identified my upcoming presentation as a stressor during the wellbeing workshop on campus.
examples.zh: 在校内身心健康工作坊中，我发现即将进行的汇报是一个「压力源」。

words.enDefinition: ways a person deals with difficulties, emotions, or stress

examples.en: We discussed coping strategies that I had already tried during my first term.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了我第一学期已经尝试过的「应对策略」。

examples.en: The workshop compared coping strategies that different students said were helpful to them.
examples.zh: 工作坊比较了不同学生自述有用的「应对策略」。

words.enDefinition: learned abilities that help someone deal with stressful situations

examples.en: The workshop outline said students would discuss coping skills in small groups.
examples.zh: 工作坊提纲说，学生会分小组讨论「应对技能」。

examples.en: I talked about coping skills I had learnt while studying far from home.
examples.zh: 我谈到了自己离家读书时学到的「应对技能」。

words.enDefinition: a session where participants learn and discuss ways to handle stress

examples.en: I found the stress management workshop listed under the department's exam support activities.
examples.zh: 我在院里的考试支持活动列表上找到了「压力管理工作坊」。

examples.en: A classmate recommended the stress management workshop after seeing a notice at the library.
examples.zh: 一位同学在图书馆看到公告后，向我推荐了「压力管理工作坊」。

collocations: register for a stress management workshop

words.enDefinition: a group session about aspects of wellbeing

examples.en: I asked whether the wellbeing workshop was open to postgraduate students as well.
examples.zh: 我问研究生是否也能参加「身心健康工作坊」。

examples.en: The wellbeing workshop took place in the student union building after our morning classes.
examples.zh: 「身心健康工作坊」在我们上午下课后，于学生会大楼里举行。

words.enDefinition: careful thinking about one's own experiences, feelings, or behaviour

examples.en: We spent the last part of the workshop writing notes for self-reflection.
examples.zh: 工作坊最后一段时间，我们写笔记进行「自我反思」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what self-reflection had been like for me during the semester.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，学期里「自我反思」对我来说是什么样的体验。

words.enDefinition: something that can bring on a stress response

examples.en: I noticed that unexpected changes to my timetable were a stress trigger for me.
examples.zh: 我发现课表突然变动对我来说是一个「压力触发因素」。

examples.en: We discussed which stress trigger appeared most often during the weeks before exams.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了考前几周哪种「压力触发因素」出现得最频繁。

words.enDefinition: feeling disconnected from emotions or unable to feel them fully

examples.en: I used emotional numbness to describe feeling distant from things I usually cared about.
examples.zh: 我用「情感麻木」来形容自己对平时在意的事情感到疏离。

examples.en: The counselor asked what emotional numbness felt like to me in daily life.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我在日常生活中体会到的「情感麻木」是什么感觉。

words.enDefinition: tiredness that makes thinking or paying attention harder

examples.en: I noticed mental fatigue after spending most of the week reading for my course.
examples.zh: 那周大部分时间都在读课程材料，我感到了「脑力疲劳」。

examples.en: The seminar discussed mental fatigue in students who spend long stretches studying alone.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论了长时间独自学习的学生所感受到的「脑力疲劳」。

words.enDefinition: harsh judgment of one's own actions, qualities, or mistakes

examples.en: We talked about self-criticism and how it showed up after I received feedback.
examples.zh: 我们聊了「自我苛责」，以及我收到反馈后会怎么责怪自己。

examples.en: I noticed more self-criticism when I compared my progress with other students' work.
examples.zh: 把自己的进展和其他同学的成果一比，我发现自己更容易「自我苛责」。

words.enDefinition: critical or discouraging things a person says to themselves

examples.en: I noticed negative self-talk while preparing to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 准备在全班面前发言时，我留意到自己的「消极自我对话」。

examples.en: The workshop discussed negative self-talk that sometimes follows a difficult group project.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了做完较困难的小组项目后有时会出现的「消极自我对话」。

words.enDefinition: a tendency to expect extremely high standards and avoid mistakes

examples.en: I brought up perfectionism when we talked about how I rewrote my assignments.
examples.zh: 我们谈我怎么反复改作业时，我提到了「完美主义」。

examples.en: Our adviser discussed perfectionism with students who worried about submitting their first draft.
examples.zh: 顾问和担心交初稿的学生们讨论了「完美主义」。

words.enDefinition: persistent doubts about whether one deserves one's achievements or position

examples.en: I heard about impostor syndrome during a discussion with other first-year doctoral students.
examples.zh: 和其他博士一年级学生讨论时，我听说了「冒名顶替感」。

examples.en: The seminar explored impostor syndrome among students who had just entered a competitive programme.
examples.zh: 研讨课探讨了刚进入竞争激烈项目的学生所面临的「冒名顶替感」。

words.enDefinition: becoming less certain about one's abilities or judgments

examples.en: I noticed a loss of confidence after receiving feedback on my first essay.
examples.zh: 第一篇论文收到反馈后，我察觉自己「信心减退」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the loss of confidence also affected how I spoke in class.
examples.zh: 顾问问「信心减退」是否也影响了我在课堂上的发言。

words.enDefinition: a persistently low opinion of one's own value

examples.en: I asked what low self-esteem meant in the student health service's information booklet.
examples.zh: 我问学生健康服务手册里的「低自尊」是什么意思。

examples.en: The counselor asked if low self-esteem affected how I interpreted other people's comments.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，「低自尊」是否会影响我理解别人评论的方式。

words.enDefinition: a state of significant emotional upset or suffering

examples.en: The service described who students could contact when they experienced emotional distress on campus.
examples.zh: 服务部门说明了学生在校园里遇到「情绪困扰」可以联系谁。

examples.en: My tutor asked how the emotional distress affected my ability to finish the project.
examples.zh: 导师问「情绪困扰」是怎么影响我完成项目的。

words.enDefinition: to decide and communicate a limit on what you will accept

examples.en: We talked about how to set a boundary when friends ask for favours during exam week.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了考试周朋友求帮忙时，怎样「设定界限」。

examples.en: I wanted to set a boundary around late-night project messages in our group chat.
examples.zh: 我想针对群里深夜发来的项目消息「设定界限」。

collocations: set a boundary with a friend
find it hard to set a boundary

words.enDefinition: the limits someone sets for their relationships and personal space

examples.en: The workshop discussed personal boundaries in shared housing and between classmates working together.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了合租生活及同学合作中的「个人界限」。

examples.en: I explained how my personal boundaries had changed after moving into a shared flat.
examples.zh: 我解释了搬进合租公寓后，「个人界限」怎么变了。

words.enDefinition: to help people have a realistic idea of what to expect

examples.en: We discussed how to manage expectations when I could only attend on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了我只能周五参加时，怎样「协调彼此的预期」。

examples.en: My adviser asked what I was doing to manage expectations in the group project.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在小组项目里怎么「协调彼此的预期」。

words.enDefinition: agreeing to do more than one can reasonably manage

examples.en: My counselor used overcommitment to describe the pattern we noticed in my weekly schedule.
examples.zh: 咨询师用「承担过多任务」来形容我们在我每周安排中发现的情况。

examples.en: The workshop discussed overcommitment during the first semester of studying away from home.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了离家上学第一学期「承担过多任务」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a place with little noise or activity where someone can spend time

examples.en: The student centre has a quiet space away from the main corridor.
examples.zh: 学生中心有一处远离主走廊的「安静空间」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a quiet space for my online counseling call.
examples.zh: 我问有没有「安静空间」，方便我接线上咨询通话。

words.enDefinition: a survey about how students are feeling and managing daily life

examples.en: Our department sent a student wellbeing survey at the end of the term.
examples.zh: 学期末，我们系发了一份「学生身心健康调查」。

examples.en: I completed the student wellbeing survey after reading how the university would use it.
examples.zh: 看了学校会如何使用调查结果后，我填了「学生身心健康调查」。

collocations: results from a student wellbeing survey

words.enDefinition: a group session about adapting to challenges and recovering after setbacks

examples.en: The resilience workshop included a discussion about adjusting after our first term abroad.
examples.zh: 「心理韧性工作坊」讨论了出国第一学期后的适应问题。

examples.en: I asked when the resilience workshop would run again because the first session was full.
examples.zh: 第一次已经报满了，我问「心理韧性工作坊」什么时候还会开。

words.enDefinition: to make the amount of work you are responsible for smaller

examples.en: The workshop leader asked how you could reduce your workload during busy weeks.
examples.zh: 工作坊带领者问，忙碌的几周里你可以怎么「减少任务量」。

examples.en: The workshop discussed how to reduce your workload when too many commitments overlap.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了承诺的事情挤在一起时，怎么「减少任务量」。

collocations: find a way to reduce your workload

words.zhGloss: 心理健康相关学习便利
words.enDefinition: adjustments that help people with mental health needs take part
acceptedZhAnswers: 心理健康相关学习便利

examples.en: I asked which mental health accommodations were available for my laboratory classes this term.
examples.zh: 我问这学期的实验课可以提供哪些「心理健康相关学习便利」。

examples.en: The student office explained who handles requests for mental health accommodations at our university.
examples.zh: 学生办公室说明了本校由谁处理「心理健康相关学习便利」的申请。

words.enDefinition: time formally taken away from studies because of health concerns

examples.en: I asked how leave for health reasons might affect my place on the course.
examples.zh: 我问「因健康原因休学」可能对我的课程名额有什么影响。

examples.en: The adviser explained which forms were used to request leave for health reasons.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了申请「因健康原因休学」需要哪些表格。

collocations: apply for leave for health reasons

words.enDefinition: a period away from studies or work for mental wellbeing

examples.en: I talked to my course adviser about taking time off for mental health.
examples.zh: 我跟课程顾问谈了谈「为照顾心理健康请假」的事。

examples.en: The student guide lists who to contact about time off for mental health.
examples.zh: 学生指南列出了要「为照顾心理健康请假」可以联系谁。

collocations: take time off for mental health
request time off for mental health
consider time off for mental health

words.enDefinition: an agreed plan for returning to classes after a break

examples.en: My adviser and I discussed a return-to-study plan before the new term started.
examples.zh: 新学期开始前，我和顾问讨论了「复学计划」。

examples.en: The return-to-study plan included a meeting with the department during my first week back.
examples.zh: 「复学计划」里安排我在回校第一周和院里见面。

words.enDefinition: a transfer involving a direct introduction to the next person providing support

examples.en: The counselor offered a warm handoff and introduced me to the wellbeing adviser in person.
examples.zh: 咨询师提供了「直接引介式转接」，当面把我介绍给身心健康顾问。

examples.en: I had a warm handoff by video before my first meeting with the new service.
examples.zh: 我与新机构第一次见面前，通过视频接受了「直接引介式转接」。

words.enDefinition: local support and care for people with mental health concerns

examples.en: The university adviser explained how to contact the community mental health service after graduation.
examples.zh: 学校顾问说明了毕业后如何联系「社区心理健康服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the community mental health service offered appointments near my new flat.
examples.zh: 我查了「社区心理健康服务」是否在我新公寓附近有可约的地点。

collocations: contact a community mental health service
access a community mental health service

words.enDefinition: a recommendation to continue therapy with a service offering longer-term care

examples.en: The counselor offered a referral to long-term therapy as the semester was ending.
examples.zh: 学期快结束时，咨询师建议给我做「长期心理治疗转介」。

examples.en: I asked whether the referral to long-term therapy could be sent to a clinic nearby.
examples.zh: 我问「长期心理治疗转介」能不能发到附近的诊所。

collocations: arrange a referral to long-term therapy
request a referral to long-term therapy
receive a referral to long-term therapy

words.zhGloss: 按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询
words.enDefinition: counseling priced according to what the client can afford
acceptedZhAnswers: 按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询

examples.en: My adviser showed me a directory of clinics offering sliding-scale counseling near campus.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份学校附近提供「按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询」的诊所名录。

examples.en: I called about sliding-scale counseling and asked what documents the centre would need.
examples.zh: 我打电话咨询「按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询」，问中心需要哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: a group where students discuss adjusting to new academic or social settings

examples.en: I joined a student adjustment group in my first month on the exchange programme.
examples.zh: 参加交换项目第一个月，我加入了「学生适应互助小组」。

examples.en: The student adjustment group met in the same room as my evening seminar.
examples.zh: 「学生适应互助小组」用的就是我晚间研讨课的教室。

words.enDefinition: brief questions or tools used to identify possible mental health concerns

examples.en: The university explained what mental health screening was for before sending out its survey.
examples.zh: 学校发问卷之前，解释了「心理健康筛查」是做什么的。

examples.en: I asked whether the mental health screening was part of the first appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「心理健康筛查」是不是第一次会面的其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: a questionnaire used to identify possible issues for further assessment

examples.en: The counselor explained who would see the screening questionnaire after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了我交完「筛查问卷」之后会有哪些人看。

examples.en: I filled out the screening questionnaire in the waiting area before my appointment started.
examples.zh: 咨询开始前，我在等候区填了「筛查问卷」。

words.enDefinition: to bring a particular meeting with a counselor to a close

examples.en: I asked how to end a counseling session if the building was closing early.
examples.zh: 如果大楼要提前关门，我问了该怎么「结束心理咨询会谈」。

examples.en: The training showed several ways to end a counseling session without rushing the client.
examples.zh: 培训展示了几种「结束心理咨询会谈」的方式，不用催促来访者。

collocations: prepare to end a counseling session
time to end a counseling session
decide when to end a counseling session

words.zhGloss: 联系并关心某人的近况
words.enDefinition: to contact a person to see how they are doing
acceptedZhAnswers: 联系并关心某人的近况

examples.en: After the exams, I wanted to check in on someone from my study group.
examples.zh: 考试过后，我想「联系并关心一下」学习小组里一位同学的近况。

examples.en: We talked about how to check in on someone who had missed several meetings.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了该怎么「联系并关心」一位缺席了几次聚会的同学。

collocations: offer to check in on someone
remember to check in on someone
take time to check in on someone

words.enDefinition: the process of managing and responding to one's emotions

examples.en: The workshop included a discussion of emotional regulation during stressful parts of the term.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了学期里压力大时的「情绪调节」。

examples.en: I asked the tutor what emotional regulation meant in our wellbeing course outline.
examples.zh: 我问导师，身心健康课程大纲里的「情绪调节」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: worry about not succeeding at a task or goal

examples.en: My tutor asked whether fear of failure made it harder to start my assignments.
examples.zh: 导师问，「对失败的恐惧」是否让我更难动笔写作业。

examples.en: The workshop discussed fear of failure among students preparing for their first practical exams.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了准备第一次实操考试的学生所经历的「对失败的恐惧」。

words.enDefinition: a workable balance between working demands and personal time

examples.en: The counselor asked about work-life balance because I had started a weekend job.
examples.zh: 我开始做周末兼职后，咨询师问起了我的「工作与生活平衡」。

examples.en: We discussed work-life balance while looking at the hours I spent studying and working.
examples.zh: 我们看了看我学习和工作花的时间，同时讨论了「工作与生活平衡」。
